public_hostnames.auth.example.net: Pocket-ID is the identity provider Access authenticates against; guarding it is circular
public_hostnames.immich.example.net: authenticates via OIDC against Pocket-ID; Access breaks the iOS app, which cannot send CF-Access-Client-Id headers
public_hostnames.music.example.net: Subsonic clients cannot complete an interactive Access login; gated instead by a Cloudflare WAF rule matching the x-key header (the expression must spell that header lowercase or it 403s everything)
